text:
Press Note
Food Safety and Standards (Food Product Standards and Food Additives)
First Amendment Regulation, 2017
Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has notified the Final Food Safety
and Standards (Food Product Standards and Food Additives) Amendment
Regulation, 2017 in the official gazette of India w.r.t oils, fats, oats and pasta.
This regulation prescribes new standards for ‘Oats’. This product is becoming
more popular and is consumed widely. With the standards in place, these
products would be effectively regulated for their food safety and quality.
 The Amendment Regulation also includes revised standards for pasta products.
Currently, only suji and maida are permitted for preparation of pasta products.
The proposed revision also lists additional ingredient such as rice flour,
groundnut flour, tapioca flour, edible soy flour or flour of any other cereal etc
which also can be used for preparation of pasta products.
Furthermore, the amendment regulation also includes redefinition of the
Interesterified Vegetable Fat and usage of food grade enzyme for oil
degumming in refining process.
These standards have been finalised after consideration of the comments
received from stakeholders in this respect and shall come into force on 1st July,
2017.
